name: 🧀 Loaded Nachos
what: A sheet pan of chips, beef, beans and cheese, baked and loaded with toppings.

core.name: Tortilla chips
core.out: tortillas cut in triangles, baked 8 minutes

extras: ground beef + taco seasoning, sour cream, avocado, jalapeños, green onions, lime

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 400°F. Foil on a big sheet pan.
If using beef: brown it, drain, add taco seasoning and a little water.
Half the chips in one layer, then half the cheese, beans and beef. Repeat.
Bake until the cheese is fully melted.
Top with salsa, sour cream and avocado. Eat off the pan.

key: Two thin layers, not a mountain, so every chip gets cheese.
plan_b: No chips? Quesadillas with the same filling.
